astranl.do_not_use_when: you need a quote, an individual permit or a person
astranl.example_intent: Which public works tenders close this month?
astranl.next_possible_action: cite the provenance; the same fact is at https://astranl.com/api/construction
astranl.proof_level: register of TenderNed works publications; not signed
astranl.returns: n_open and tenders with buyer, cpv, dates, link; register provenance
astranl.use_when: you look for open public construction works tenders in the Netherlands

description: Open Dutch public works tenders from TenderNed (announcements with a future closing date): buyer, CPV, procedure, published and closing date, days left, European flag, TenderNed id and link. Tender names are not returned; open the link for the full notice. Read-only aggregates: no permit rows, publication identifiers, titles, addresses, points or names; permit counts below 5 per authority per kind are shown as <5 and totals that would reveal one are lower bounds (>=n). Every answer carries source provenance (source, source_url, licence, as_of/retrieved_at, method, status) and an exposure block.
name: construction_tenders
